title: backlog part 1: counts, rank, badges, add, propose, findings + scoped git argv + allowed-type refusal text
action: Port the backlog group PART 1: counts, rank, badges, add, propose, findings. On review this cell was the largest in the batch and was SPLIT: pbi.*, render/--check and the PBI lock conformance moved to rpl-9. Handlers live in packages/bee/bee.mjs:3670-4007 (REVIEW-CORRECTED range — handleBacklogFindings sits at 3997-4007, entirely outside the old 3670-3944); lib at packages/bee/lib/backlog.mjs. Extend crates/bee-core/src/backlog.rs (today read-only). TWO exact-replication requirements. (1) UNLOCKED APPENDS: plain add/propose/findings appends are bare, unlocked appendJsonl (bee.mjs:3832) — do NOT introduce a lock mjs does not take. (2) GIT SIDE EFFECT: backlog.add shells out via runBacklogGit (bee.mjs:3773-3786) with a pathspec scoped ONLY to .bee/backlog.jsonl; the comment at bee.mjs:3736-3743 records that widening this scope was a past regression. REVIEW-FOUND GAP — the git-argv assertion had no stated mechanism, and the obvious one is a trap: a cross-runtime argv diff cannot see an in-process node seam, so the only route is a PATH `git` shim both legs pick up that logs argv and cwd to a file, and that file MUST land inside the diffed tree and OUTSIDE the exclusion prefixes at crates/bee-parity/src/differ.rs:28 (.bee/logs, .bee/cache, .bee/tmp, .bee/runtime). State the chosen path in the worker block. (3) ALLOWED-TYPE REFUSAL TEXT: bee.mjs:3687 backlogAllowedTypes() = [...Object.keys(KIND_ALIASES), ...NORMALIZED_KINDS].sort() IS the `--type` refusal message. Consume the constants rpl-3 ported into bee-core — hardcoding a second list is a D7 violation. REVIEW-FOUND FIXTURE GAP: every generated backlog row is type `proposal` (crates/queen-bench/src/fixture.rs:296), so counts/rank/badges scenarios must SEED the row variety they assert on via rpl-1's per-scenario seeding. Also assert this group's unknown-verb usage fallback line (packages/bee/bee.mjs:6586-6609).

truths: cargo run --release --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml -p bee-parity -- --cmd-check --group backlog reports every part-1 backlog scenario clean

the git argv and cwd emitted by backlog.add are asserted equal to mjs, scoped to .bee/backlog.jsonl only, via a shim whose log lands outside every exclusion prefix — proven by a negative control that alters the argv and IS caught

no lock is taken by the plain add/propose/findings path in either runtime
the backlog unknown-verb usage fallback line is byte-identical to mjs
